title: Farmers, Hunters, and Colonists
summary: Eight contributors discuss early trade relations between Plains and Pueblo farmers, the evolution of interdependence between Plains hunter-gatherers and Pueblo farmers between 1450 and 1700, and the later comanchero trade between Hispanic New Mexicans and the Plains Comanche. Contributors: Timothy G. Baugh Judith A. Habicht-Mauche Frances Levine Christopher Lintz David H. Snow John D. Speth Katherine A. Spielmann David R. Wilcox
